revenue.measure: growth of total operating revenues (net of volume and support incentives), %

net_to_gross.measure: change in total operating revenues as a share of gross operating revenues (service, data processing, international transaction and other revenues before volume and support incentives), bp: the share of gross revenues kept after client incentives, in the place of the gross margin

opex_gap.measure: growth of operating expenses excluding the litigation provision line, less revenue growth, pp (lower is better)

receivables_gap.measure: growth of year-end accounts receivable less revenue growth, pp (lower is better), each pair of year ends from the latest filing published by 2009-10-29 whose balance sheet reports both (the S-4/A for 2005-2006, the 424B4 for 2006-2007, the FY2008 10-K for 2007-2008), with that filing's revenues

op_margin.measure: change in operating margin (operating income over total operating revenues, litigation provisions in, as published), bp
